name: Sukoyaka Family Clinic
description: A calm, photograph-led theme for a family medical clinic: linen ground, stone panels and ink text with a single oitake muted green accent, Literata over Source Sans 3. The home page opens with a quiet text-left, photograph-right first screen and a slim opening-hours line, then a welcome from the founder with two photographs, a visit from reception to the dispensary as one vertical path with four photographed stops, the two doctors and the nursing team, care for every age, opening hours, vaccinations and health checks as plain lists, the journal and how to find us. With Care, Your visit, Doctors and nurses, Families, Vaccinations and checks, About, Contact, Newsletter and Journal. The clinic details are one synced pattern, edited once. Sample content in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German.
